name: dashboards
description: Living dashboards: pages of prompt-driven cards (KPIs, tables, lists, charts, text) over your drive files, with per-card runs, version history and full AI tooling.
help: Dashboards are pages of cards — KPIs, tables, lists, charts and text — that live on your drives like files: they are indexed, searchable and keep a full version history.

Each card carries a natural-language prompt plus references to files attached to the dashboard. Running a card executes the prompt and snapshots the result, so the page reads instantly — every card has a refresh icon and the page has a run-all action.
Files are attached to the dashboard itself — either uploaded into the dashboard's folder or linked from your drives — and cards reference attachments by id.

Ask the AI to build or maintain dashboards: it can create pages with cards, attach your drive files, wire cards to them, run cards and suggest concrete edits — one answer leaves a single restorable history entry. Detaching an upload-origin file deletes it; linked originals are never touched.

Results depend on the shape of the model's answer: KPI, chart and table cards look their best when the model returns the requested JSON. If a run comes back as plain text instead, nothing is broken — a run never fails for this — just run the card again for a fresh answer.

Each run can be capped with a per-card AI step budget, and the run console shows what the agent is doing step by step — which files it reads and what it concludes — live while the card runs, with the full trace kept on the snapshot. Detaching is refused while any card still links the file; the eye toggle shows which cards use it.

Script cards compute deterministically instead of prompting: turn the Script card toggle on and write a pyrun script over the dashboard's attachments — attachments are the script's inputs, and the result is coerced into the card's snapshot (KPI and chart cards first-class). No prompt is sent and no AI steps are spent.
